upgrades.descriptionEn: Levitate upward while charging the Beam Ripper.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 為 Beam Ripper 蓄力時向上浮起。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Ammo reserves are increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 增加備用彈藥量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage falloff is reversed. Max damage is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 反轉傷害衰減曲線，並提高最大傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased while airborne.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滯空時提高傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire a javelin that deals increased impact damage and creates a shock explosion after a short duration.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 發射衝擊傷害更高的標槍，短暫延遲後產生電擊爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Charge-up speed is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 提高蓄力速度。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Direct hits deal increased damage while sprinting.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 衝刺時，直接命中造成更高傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire full-auto at a higher fire rate. Magazine size is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 改為全自動射擊，提高射速與彈匣容量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: After a short delay, a trail of explosions follows your projectile's path.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 短暫延遲後，沿投射物的飛行路徑接連爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Firing pushes you backward. Ammo used for shots that don't hit any targets is refunded to reserves.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射擊會把自己向後推；未擊中任何目標的彈藥會退回備彈。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Create a bee explosion when you reload that damages you and nearby enemies. Explosion size and amount of bees increase for each burst fired before reloading.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填時產生蜜蜂爆炸，傷害自己與附近敵人。裝填前點放的次數越多，爆炸範圍與蜜蜂數量越多。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold R to consume your grenade and convert the rest of your magazine into explosive bullets of that grenade's element. Non-elemental grenade damage is converted to bees.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住 R 消耗手榴彈，將彈匣內剩餘子彈轉成同元素的爆炸彈；無元素手榴彈會轉成蜜蜂。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Dealing damage with your other weapon no longer refills the Accelerator's magazine. Ammo capacity is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 另一把武器造成傷害時，不再補充 Accelerator 彈匣；提高備彈容量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Range is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射程增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold R to consume your grenade and convert the rest of your magazine into explosive bullets of that grenade's element.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住 R 消耗手榴彈，將彈匣剩餘彈藥轉為與該手榴彈同元素的爆炸彈。

upgrades.descriptionEn: After firing a burst, gain a burst of speed for each bullet fired.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 完成一輪點放後，每射出一發子彈就獲得一次短促加速。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Reload speed is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填速度提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Enables full-auto firing. Burst interval is slightly increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 啟用全自動射擊。點放間隔略微增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a target grants a stacking bonus to fire rate and reload speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺目標時，獲得可疊加的射速與裝填速度加成。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Shoot allies with bee bullets to heal them.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以蜜蜂子彈射擊隊友可治療他們。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage increases based on how fast you're moving. Base damage is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 移動越快，傷害越高。基礎傷害降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Deal more damage but apply less shock.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害提高，但施加的電擊減少。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: On reload, you warp back in time to a previous position, then gain a small speed boost and create an explosion.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填時回溯至先前的位置，隨後獲得小幅速度提升並產生爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Direct hits deal increased damage while sprinting.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 衝刺時，直接命中造成的傷害提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Commandeers 1 column from each of your other upgrade grids.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 從其他每個升級配件棋盤各徵用 1 欄。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Every burst fires 5 bullets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每輪點放發射 5 發子彈。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire a tracking missile at the end of each burst. The missile's damage and explosion size increase with burst size.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每輪點放結束時發射一枚追蹤飛彈。每輪發射的子彈越多，飛彈傷害與爆炸範圍越大。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Upon taking damage, you have a chance to fire out a tracking missile.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到傷害時，有機率發射追蹤飛彈。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Bullets apply more of their elemental effect.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 子彈施加更多元素效果。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Bullets have a small chance to explode on impact.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 子彈有小幅機率在命中時爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain a burst of speed when reloading with an empty magazine.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈匣清空後裝填時，獲得一次短促加速。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your magazine is refilled when you are electrocuted.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 觸電時，彈匣補滿。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: After you are swarmed by bees, the Accelerator deals increased damage, you move faster, and you fall slower.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被蜜蜂群纏上後，提高 Accelerator 傷害與移動速度，並減慢下落速度。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire one massive burst.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 一次進行超大量點放射擊。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Generate ammo over time while sprinting. If bees are applied to your bullets, your ammo regenerates faster while airborne.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 衝刺時隨時間產生彈藥。子彈帶有蜜蜂效果時，滯空期間彈藥恢復更快。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Magazine size is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈匣容量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a target grants a stacking move speed bonus.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺目標時，獲得可疊加的移動速度加成。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Bullet size is increased while sprinting.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 衝刺時，子彈尺寸增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Each stack of the Accelerator's element you apply to targets before reloading increases the chance to refund your last burst. Some stacks are consumed upon refund.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 換彈前施加的 Accelerator 元素層數越多，退還上一輪連發彈藥的機率越高；退還時會消耗部分層數。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Create a healing swarm of bees when you reload. After a short duration, the bees begin to damage you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填時產生治療蜂群。短時間後，蜜蜂開始對你造成傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: While holding the Accelerator, you regenerate health more quickly the faster you're moving. Regen speed is further increased when the Accelerator's element is fully applied to you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手持 Accelerator 時，移動越快，生命恢復越快。自身完整承受 Accelerator 所屬元素效果時，恢復速度會進一步提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire 3 pellets per shot with less accuracy.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每次射擊發射 3 顆彈丸，準確度降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Unstable recursion leading to unstable recursion leading to unstable recursion leading to
upgrades.descriptionZh: 不穩定遞迴導致不穩定遞迴導致不穩定遞迴導致
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Applies bees.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 施加蜜蜂效果。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenade applies less of its element to you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈對你施加的元素量減少。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades activate your employee's secondary ability on impact.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈撞擊時，會啟動所用角色的次要技能。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Cooldown is reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 冷卻時間縮短。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: You have a chance to create an acid explosion when you take damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到傷害時，有機率產生酸液爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades apply rot to metallic targets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈會對金屬目標施加腐朽。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hitting an electrocuted target with your grenade ignites it.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以手榴彈命中觸電目標時，會將其點燃。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades explode into lingering acid puddles.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈爆炸後，會留下持續存在的酸液池。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenade recharges faster while standing in an acid puddle.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 站在酸液池中時，手榴彈的充能速度提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Throw 2 grenades at once in a larger spread. Explosion size is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以更大的散布範圍同時投擲 2 枚手榴彈。爆炸範圍縮小。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Players hit by your grenade's explosion gain movement ability charge. Cooldown is slightly reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被手榴彈爆炸命中的玩家，會獲得移動技能能量。冷卻時間略微縮短。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Sliding will periodically throw out your grenade without consuming a charge. Stacking this upgrade throws additional grenades.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滑行時，會定期拋出不消耗使用次數的手榴彈。疊加此升級配件可拋出額外的手榴彈。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades call in a heavy weapon drop on impact. Cooldown is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈撞擊時，會呼叫重型武器空投。冷卻時間延長。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Taking damage from any source other than your grenade provides some grenade charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到自身手榴彈以外的任何來源傷害時，獲得部分手榴彈能量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.nameEn: In For A Penny, In For A Pound
upgrades.descriptionEn: Taking damage from any source other than your grenade has a small chance to toss out a grenade. This chance is proportional to the amount of damage taken.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到自身手榴彈以外的任何來源傷害時，有小機率拋出一枚手榴彈。此機率與受到的傷害量成正比。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Awarded as a special drop.
upgrades.acquisitionZh: 特殊掉落獎勵；此來源未列更詳細條件。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades cost health to fire and no longer have a cooldown.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 發射手榴彈改為消耗生命，並取消冷卻時間。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Teleport to your grenade when it lands.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈落地時，傳送到其位置。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Commandeers 1 column from each of your other upgrade grids.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 從其他每個升級配件棋盤各徵用 1 欄。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades have a chance to create a second explosion of a random element.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈有機率產生第二次爆炸，元素隨機。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Explosion size is increased, but so is cooldown.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 爆炸範圍增加，但冷卻時間也會延長。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenade is partially recharged when you get hit by an enemy's overclocked explosion. You gain more charge the closer you are to the explosion's epicenter. Overclocked explosions that would kill you instead reduce your health to 1.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被敵人的超頻爆炸命中時，手榴彈會恢復部分能量。越靠近爆炸中心，獲得的能量越多。足以致命的超頻爆炸會改為將你的生命值降至 1。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades give nearby players an overshield on impact.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈撞擊時，會給予附近玩家額外護盾。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades are thrown with more force and aren't affected by gravity.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈的投擲力量提高，且不受重力影響。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: While standing still, your grenade recharges faster and you gain damage resistance.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 站立不動時，手榴彈充能更快，並獲得傷害抗性。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Any outgoing damage matching this grenade's element is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 你造成的傷害若與此手榴彈的元素相同，傷害會提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades pull targets in before exploding.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈爆炸前，會將目標拉向自身。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Activating your Shield Projector launches you backward.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 啟動護盾投射器時，將你向後彈射。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hit allies with your Nose Dive to reload their weapons.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊命中隊友時，為他們的武器裝填。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Health is increased, but run speed is slightly decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 生命提高，但奔跑速度略微降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Slide in the air to cannonball downwards at great speeds. Hitting the ground with enough force triggers a special Nose Dive impact that deals increased damage but has less potent effects.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 在空中滑行，可像砲彈般高速向下墜落。以足夠力道撞地時，會觸發特殊的俯衝撞擊，傷害更高，但附加效果較弱。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Awarded by redeeming the 2FA Code: Bruiser item.
upgrades.acquisitionZh: 兌換「2FA Code: Bruiser」道具取得。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive’s blast radius increases based on how far you dove.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝距離越遠，俯衝撞擊的爆炸半徑越大。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 3 (requires 5 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Jump during a Nose Dive to cancel it and keep your momentum.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊期間按跳躍，可取消俯衝並保留動量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 1 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 1 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Shield Projector is now a dome.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 護盾投射器改為圓頂形。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Shield Projector pushes enemies away with more force.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 護盾投射器以更大的力量推開敵人。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive blast radius is increased, but damage is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊爆炸半徑增加，但傷害降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 1 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 1 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain a second Nose Dive charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊可額外儲存 1 次使用次數。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Leap with more force when activating Nose Dive.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 啟動俯衝撞擊時，起跳力量提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 3 (requires 5 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive pushes targets away from you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊會將目標推離你。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 1 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 1 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Shield Projector applies the given element to targets within its impact zone. Cooldown is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 護盾投射器會對落點區域內的目標施加指定元素。冷卻時間增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Shield Projector creates a large cube that traps enemies inside. Players inside the cube heal over time. Shield duration is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 護盾投射器改為大型立方體，將敵人困在其中；內部玩家持續回血，護盾持續時間也更長。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 6 (requires 18 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 6 階（需先花費 18 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Nose Dive impact creates a temporary bubble shield.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊落地時，產生暫時的泡泡護盾。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive cooldown is reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 俯衝撞擊冷卻時間縮短。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Press P 3 times to detonate yourself.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按 P 3 次即可自爆。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive releases a bolt of lightning that arcs between up to 12 targets.

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Landing a Nose Dive briefly empowers your next shield, increasing its damage and reducing its duration. This shield refunds some charge when it runs out.

upgrades.acquisitionZh: 特殊掉落獎勵；此來源未列更詳細條件。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold F to gain damage resistance and draw the attention of all enemies for a short time.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive applies whatever element you were last affected by.

upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your leap travels much further.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 躍起時的移動距離大幅增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 3 (requires 5 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nose Dive pulls targets toward you.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Shield Projector grants all nearby players an overshield when placed.

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Allies hit by your Nose Dive become briefly immune.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被俯衝撞擊命中的隊友短暫無敵。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Bruiser skill tree at Tier 3 (requires 5 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 透過 With Me 讓隊友無敵時，你也會短暫無敵。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Bruiser 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。需先解鎖 With Me。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈匣容量增加。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用電鋸時，會偏轉飛來的投射物，並獲得傷害抗性。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a core generates a small amount of reserve ammo for your equipped heavy weapon.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺核心時，為目前裝備的重武器生成少量備彈。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 被點燃時，為彈匣返還彈藥。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 按下技能鍵束縛附近敵人，快速移動可重新充能。（來源未標示按鍵。）

upgrades.descriptionZh: 從其他每個升級配件棋盤各徵用 1 欄。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺目標時有機率掉落生命碎塊。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 施加火焰效果。電鋸啟動越久，效果越強。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺目標可獲得狂怒層數。只要持續使用電鋸，狂怒就會提高移動速度與傷害。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 備用彈藥量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionZh: 開火時，定期釋放脈衝，治療附近的其他玩家。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用電鋸時移動更快，但受到更多傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害提高，但使用電鋸時受到的傷害增加。

upgrades.descriptionZh: Nutritious Cores 也會為隊友生成生命碎塊。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionZh: 觸電後，短時間內電鋸運轉速度提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Upon reaching the given threshold, all stacks of blood are consumed and your movement ability is partially recharged.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 達到指定門檻時，消耗全部鮮血層數，並為移動技能補充部分能量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Pull nearby grunts toward you while sawing.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用電鋸時，將附近的普通兵吸向自己。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害範圍擴大。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住 R 消耗全部血液，依消耗層數暫時提高傷害；效果期間無法獲得血液。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 蓄力時承受的傷害降低。蓄力時間增加。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填速度提高，但彈匣容量降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fires slow-moving plasma that deals increased damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 發射速度較慢、傷害較高的電漿。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Enemies you corrode with any weapon have a chance to return ammo to the magazine over time.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被你以任何武器施加腐蝕的敵人，有機會隨時間返還彈藥至彈匣。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Bullets apply acid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 子彈施加酸液。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 持續射擊時，每射出第 15 發子彈會治療你。

upgrades.descriptionZh: Hamhock Saxon 曾被認為發明了圓；可惜研究者找到大量證據，證明圓在他出生前就已存在。（來源為背景敘述。）

upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Magazine size is increased for each empty cell touching this upgrade.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每個接觸此配件的空格都會增加彈匣容量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: You move faster while spinning the halo.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 旋轉光環時提高移動速度。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Applies cryo. Fire much slower.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 施加冰凍效果，但射速大幅降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Deal extra damage to enemy guns parts.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 對敵人的槍械部位造成額外傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Spinning the halo infuses your shots with the given element and consumes double the ammo.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 旋轉光環時，射擊附帶指定元素，但消耗雙倍彈藥。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a shell spawns a cluster of explosions. These can trigger more explosions if they destroy shells.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 摧毀外殼會產生一連串爆炸；爆炸再摧毀外殼時，可繼續觸發。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: The Diffraction Driver no longer shatters targets, but deals extra damage to frozen targets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: Diffraction Driver 不再粉碎目標，但對凍結目標造成額外傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Spinning the halo increases damage and slows you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 旋轉光環時提高傷害，同時降低自己的移動速度。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Generate more ammo from dealing damage with your other weapon.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 另一把武器造成傷害時，生成更多彈藥。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fall slower while spinning the halo.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 旋轉光環時減慢下落速度。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damaging a frozen target shatters it faster.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害凍結目標時，更快將其粉碎。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: You can fire while sprinting, but doing so applies the given element to yourself.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 可在衝刺中射擊，但射擊時會對自己施加指定元素。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Ammo reserves are increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 增加備用彈藥量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: This weapon's non-elemental damage is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 提高此武器的無元素傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: The halo changes color as you spin it. Each color provides a different damage boost.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 光環會隨旋轉改變顏色，每種顏色提供不同傷害加成。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Spinning the halo transforms the gun into a sniper, greatly increasing damage and range. A fully charged sniper shot deals full piercing damage and consumes your entire magazine.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 旋轉光環時變成狙擊槍，大幅提高傷害與射程；完全蓄力的射擊造成完整貫穿傷害，並消耗整個彈匣。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire a 4-round burst. Magazine size is slightly increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每次四連發，並略微增加彈匣容量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Deal increased damage to targets within the given range.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 對指定距離內的目標造成更高傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: When holding the trigger, successive shots have a chance to apply a random element.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 持續扣住扳機時，後續射擊有機率施加隨機元素。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold R to launch yourself upward, applying the given element to nearby targets and yourself.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住 R 將自己向上彈射，並對自己與附近目標施加指定元素。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Nullifies recoil.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 消除後座力。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Firing briefly increases your melee damage and range.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射擊後短暫提高近戰傷害與範圍。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire a lot faster with a lot more ammo and a lot less damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 大幅提高射速與彈藥量，但大幅降低傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Spinning the halo increases fire rate and decreases range. The halo no longer modifies spread or damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 旋轉光環時提高射速、降低射程；光環不再調整散布或傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Generate ammo when you shatter a target.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 粉碎目標時生成彈藥。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Toggle spinning the halo with .
upgrades.descriptionZh: 可切換光環持續旋轉。（來源未標示按鍵。）
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Launch a timed explosive when you reload.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 換彈時射出定時爆炸物。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damaging a target with the laser has a chance to arc a shocking bolt of lightning to nearby enemies.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以雷射對目標造成傷害時，有機會向附近敵人連鎖放出一道施加電擊的閃電。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Healing an ally with the laser also heals you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 用雷射治療隊友時，也會治療自己。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: The DMLR automatically switches between DMR and laser modes at the given interval, and the laser has infinite charge. Dealing damage with the DMR increases laser damage and dealing damage with the laser increases DMR damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: DMLR 會依指定間隔自動切換 DMR 與雷射模式，且雷射具有無限能量。以 DMR 造成傷害會提高雷射傷害；以雷射造成傷害則會提高 DMR 傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Ammo capacity is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈藥攜帶量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Laser damage is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 雷射傷害提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: The laser periodically emits a damaging elemental burst that becomes more powerful the longer you fire.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 雷射定期釋放造成傷害的元素衝擊；持續射擊越久，衝擊越強。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Laser damage is greatly increased, but it uses charge faster. The laser must be fully charged to fire.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 雷射傷害大幅提高，但能量消耗更快。雷射須充滿能量才能發射。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Laser deals acid damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 雷射造成酸液傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: When Voltaic Battery is equipped, you may cancel a reload by switching weapons when your magazine is empty to throw the battery again. Consecutive throws decrease the explosion's size and damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝備 Voltaic Battery 時，若彈匣已空，可切換武器取消裝填，藉此再次丟出電池。連續投擲會降低爆炸範圍與傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: The laser heals allies. Healing an ally with the laser provides some charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 雷射可治療隊友，並在治療隊友時補充部分充能。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain more laser charge from dealing damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 造成傷害時獲得更多雷射充能。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: The laser pierces shields.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 雷射可穿透護盾。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain laser charge when the given element is fully applied to you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 指定元素在你身上完全生效時，獲得雷射能量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: DMR mode deals increased damage but fires slower.
upgrades.descriptionZh: DMR 模式的傷害提高，但射速降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: The laser becomes the default mode. Dealing damage with the laser generates ammo for a more powerful DMR mode.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 雷射改為預設模式；雷射造成傷害時，為威力更強的 DMR 模式生成彈藥。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Laser deals fire damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 雷射造成火焰傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: You hover while firing the laser.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 發射雷射時會懸浮。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Range and aim zoom are increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射程與瞄準倍率提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Commandeers 1 column from each of your other upgrade grids.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 從其他每個升級配件棋盤各徵用 1 欄。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a target has a chance to refund DMR ammo.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺目標時，有機會返還 DMR 彈藥。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Move faster while firing the laser.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 發射雷射時，移動速度提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a core with the laser refunds some charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以雷射摧毀核心時，返還部分能量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Deal more damage to shells but less damage to limbs.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 對外殼造成更多傷害，但對肢體造成的傷害降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Reload speed is increased, but magazine size is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填速度提高，但彈匣容量降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Dealing damage generates more laser charge, but capacity is reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 造成傷害時產生更多雷射能量，但能量容量降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Laser charge capacity is increased, but DMR ammo capacity is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 雷射能量容量增加，但 DMR 彈藥攜帶量降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Laser deals shock damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 雷射造成電擊傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Deal more damage to limbs but less damage to shells.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 對肢體造成更多傷害，但對外殼造成的傷害降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Firing the DMR or laser spawns cryo shards.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 發射 DMR 或雷射時生成冰晶碎片。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: While firing the laser, you can't move and you gain damage resistance. Laser damage is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 發射雷射時無法移動，並獲得傷害抗性。雷射傷害提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Depleting the battery releases an elemental burst.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 電池耗盡時，釋放元素爆發。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire a 3-round burst.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每次連發 3 發。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Every 3rd bullet applies the given element.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每第 3 發子彈會施加指定元素。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Dealing damage with the laser regenerates bullets in your magazine.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以雷射造成傷害時，恢復彈匣內的子彈。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Throw used magazines on reload to create a shock explosion. Shoot the discarded mag to cause a second, larger explosion. Explosion power increases when less ammo is tossed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 換彈時拋出彈匣造成電擊爆炸；射擊丟出的彈匣可引發更大爆炸，丟棄的彈藥越少，爆炸威力越高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Create an acid explosion when you reload.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 換彈時產生酸液爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Vertical spread is negated. Horizontal spread is slightly wider.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 消除垂直散布，但略微擴大水平散布。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain increased ammo reserves and fire faster at the cost of reduced damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 提高備彈量與射速，但降低傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Magazine size is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 增加彈匣容量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire and reload faster.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 提高射速與換彈速度。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Spread is much tighter and range is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 大幅收緊散布並提高射程。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: While holding the Street Sweeper, you move slower and take reduced damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手持 Street Sweeper 時，移動更慢，但受到的傷害降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your other weapons deal increased damage for a short time after reloading the Street Sweeper.
upgrades.descriptionZh: Street Sweeper 換彈後，其他武器短暫提高傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: After reaching critical health, your next shot has reduced spread, increased damage + range, and heals you. This can't trigger again until you reach full health.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 生命降至危急後，下一發射擊收緊散布、提高傷害與射程，並治療自己；回滿生命後才能再次觸發。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: The first time your magazine and reserves are depleted, hold R to load ammo from your secret pocket directly into the magazine.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈匣與備彈首次同時耗盡時，按住 R 從秘密口袋直接裝填彈匣。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Apply more acid to all targets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 對所有目標施加的酸液量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Take less acid damage from being corroded.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被腐蝕時，受到的酸液傷害降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Health chunks provide less healing, but refund ammo to your equipped weapon.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 生命碎塊的治療量降低，但會返還目前裝備武器的彈藥。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Blink forward when you slide.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滑行時，向前閃現。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain a small burst of speed when you pick up a health chunk.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 拾取生命碎塊時，獲得小幅瞬間加速。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: You take more damage but also receive more healing from health chunks.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到的傷害提高，但從生命碎塊獲得的治療量也會提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing an enemy with a melee attack partially reloads your equipped weapon.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以近戰攻擊擊殺敵人時，目前裝備武器會填裝部分彈藥。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Converts all outgoing damage to the given element.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 將所有造成的傷害轉換為指定元素。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fully applying the primary element to a target has a chance to apply 10 stacks of the secondary element.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 對目標完全施加主要元素時，有機率施加 10 層次要元素。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain health when you stop taking damage from the given elemental effect.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 停止受到指定元素效果的傷害時，恢復生命值。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Health regeneration starts immediately when the given elemental effect wears off.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 指定元素效果消退時，立即開始生命再生。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn:
Gain 50% extra max health.

Collecting this upgrade rerolls all existing upgrades but doesn't change their patterns.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 最大生命值額外提高 50%。取得此升級配件時，會重抽所有現有升級配件，但不改變其形狀。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Apply more fire to all targets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 對所有目標施加的火焰量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Take less fire damage from being ignited.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 被點燃時，受到的火焰傷害降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: When affected by an element, any outgoing damage matching that effect is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到某種元素影響時，你造成的同元素傷害會提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a health chunk or battery grunt consumes it instantly for less healing and creates an elemental explosion.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺生命碎塊或電池小兵時，立即消耗它、獲得較少治療，並產生元素爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Small health chunks recharge your grenade, but no longer heal.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 小型生命碎塊會為手榴彈充能，但不再治療。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn:
Standard upgrades are 1 cell.
Rare upgrades are 2 cells.
Epic upgrades are 3 cells.
Exotic upgrades are 4 cells.
upgrades.descriptionZh:
Standard 升級配件占用 1 格。
Rare 升級配件占用 2 格。
Epic 升級配件占用 3 格。
Exotic 升級配件占用 4 格。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your health regenerates faster while sprinting.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 衝刺期間，生命值恢復速度提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Collecting this upgrade randomizes your employee and rerolls all existing employee upgrades, but doesn't change their patterns.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 拾取後隨機更換員工並重抽現有員工配件，但保留配件格形。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Move faster after the given element is fully applied to you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 指定元素完全施加於你後，移動速度提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Enables wallrun.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 啟用沿牆奔跑。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Commandeers 1 column from each of your other upgrade grids.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 從其他每個升級配件棋盤各徵用 1 欄。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Slide speed is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滑行速度提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing an enemy with a melee attack drops additional small health chunks.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以近戰攻擊擊殺敵人時，會額外掉落小型生命碎塊。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Health is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 生命值提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a target while mid-air grants some wingsuit charge.

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Heal yourself when you fire a salvo rocket at an ally.

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire an extra rocket. Rocket Salvo damage is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 額外發射一枚火箭。火箭齊射的傷害降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Glider skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Salvo rockets apply the given element.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 齊射火箭會施加指定元素。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Glider skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: 特殊掉落獎勵；此來源未列更詳細條件。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Melee size and damage are greatly increased for a short time after flying for at least 0.5 seconds.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛行至少 0.5 秒後，近戰攻擊範圍與傷害會在短時間內大幅提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Glider skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your wingsuit is partially recharged the first time you pick up a broken player.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 第一次抱起損壞的玩家時，翼裝恢復部分能量。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Wingsuit fly duration is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 翼裝飛行持續時間延長。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 1 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 小型生命碎塊會環繞你，直到你受到足夠傷害後才彈出。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: 特殊掉落獎勵；此來源未列更詳細條件。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Firing your Rocket Salvo while flying refunds some wingsuit charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛行時施放火箭齊射，可返還部分翼裝能量。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You deal more damage while airborne.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滯空時，造成的傷害提高。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You fall slower while aiming your Rocket Salvo.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 瞄準火箭齊射時，下落速度降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Glider skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Rocket Salvo recharges much faster, but costs health to fire.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭齊射的充能速度大幅提高，但發射會消耗生命值。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Slide out of a glide to gain a large burst of speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 從滑翔轉為滑行時，獲得大幅瞬間加速。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Glider skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You can change direction while flying.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛行期間可以改變方向。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Rocket Salvo fires a massive barrage of rockets. Cooldown is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭齊射會發射大規模火箭彈幕。冷卻時間延長。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭齊射的治療量提高。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Speed is increased when flying backward.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 向後飛行時，速度提高。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭齊射會額外發射一枚治療火箭，自動追蹤附近玩家。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 齊射火箭的傷害提高，但不再爆炸。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 發射更多火箭，但每枚火箭的傷害降低。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 1 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: 兌換「2FA Code: Glider」道具取得。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 翼裝飛行持續時間延長。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fly speed is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛行速度提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Glider skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

When you run out of fuel, your wingsuit is partially recharged and you are ignited.
This won't trigger again until your wingsuit has charged a little on its own.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 燃料耗盡時，翼裝會恢復部分能量，並將你點燃。翼裝自行恢復少量能量前，此效果不會再次觸發。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Glider skill tree at Tier 6 (requires 18 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Glider 技能樹第 6 階（需先花費 18 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fly speed is increased, but so is your Rocket Salvo's cooldown.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛行速度提高，但火箭齊射的冷卻時間也會延長。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 「洪流」產生的黏團波長度增加。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 黏團撞擊表面時，會形成向前奔流的酸液波。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 黏團威力降低，但會留下酸液池。

upgrades.descriptionZh: Globblin（原文僅有此字）

upgrades.descriptionZh: 切換至 Globbler 後，第一發傷害提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住換彈鍵消耗手榴彈充能，大幅擴大下一顆酸球的爆炸範圍；範圍也隨 Globblometer 提高。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 換彈速度降低，但提高 Globblometer。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 以更大力量發射黏團。後座力增加。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 黏團傷害提高，但下墜更快。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到傷害會累積計量，提高黏團傷害。Globblometer 越高，發射黏團時消耗的計量越少。

upgrades.descriptionZh: Globblometer 會提高彈匣容量。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 從其他每個升級配件棋盤各徵用 1 欄。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 酸球傷害到自己時，短暫獲得傷害抗性；Globblometer 會延長持續時間。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈匣容量減少。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 手持 Globbler 時，Globblometer 會提高你的移動速度。
