upgrades.descriptionZh: 發射一輪火箭齊射。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing an enemy with any weapon has a chance to regenerate reserve ammo. This chance is increased for larger enemies. Ammo refunded this way can overflow your ammo capacity up to your magazine size.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 用任何武器擊殺敵人都有機率恢復備彈，大型敵人的機率更高；如此恢復的備彈可額外溢出最多一個彈匣容量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 提高傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage dealt with your other weapons is converted into Soul Reaper stacks. Stacks are consumed on your next shot to increase damage and explosion size.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 其他武器造成的傷害轉成 Soul Reaper 層數；下一次射擊消耗層數，提高傷害與爆炸範圍。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Charge-up speed is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 提高蓄力速度。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire two rockets at once with reduced damage. Spread is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 同時發射兩枚較低傷害的火箭，並增加散布。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Firing briefly increases your move speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射擊後，短暫提高移動速度。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Ammo reserves are increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 備用彈藥量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Only one bullet is loaded into the chamber. It is much larger and deals more damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 膛室只裝填一發子彈；其尺寸與傷害皆大幅提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a core loads a collection of bullets into the magazine. Press  to fire all bullets in a large burst.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺核心會向彈匣裝入一組子彈；按下發射鍵將全部子彈大量連發。（來源未標示按鍵。）
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Range is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射程增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Bullets apply fire.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 子彈施加火焰。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: While fully affected by an element, its damage type is channeled to your bullets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 自己完全受到某元素影響時，將該傷害類型注入子彈。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Recoil and damage are reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 後座力與傷害降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a target briefly increases your damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺目標後，短暫提高傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Needs a longer trigger pull to fire. Damage is greatly increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射擊前需要更長的扳機扣壓時間。傷害大幅提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased when hip-firing.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 腰射時，傷害提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increased magazine size. Bullets randomly deal between 1% and 200% damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈匣容量增加。每發子彈隨機造成 1% 至 200% 的傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Reloading briefly increases your damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填後，短暫提高傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Magazine size is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈匣容量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased, but max fire rate is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害提高，但最大射速降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Each bullet has a chance to deal extra damage, but also has a chance to damage you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每發子彈都有機會造成額外傷害，但也有機會傷害自身。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Unloading your entire mag within the given time frame supercharges your next mag, increasing the damage of its bullets proportional to your mag size.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 在指定時間內打空彈匣，會強化下一個彈匣；子彈傷害依彈匣容量提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased, but so is recoil.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害提高，但後座力也會增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Firing your last shot has a chance to refund ammo.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射出最後一發時，有機會返還彈藥。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: The last bullet in the chamber explodes.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 膛室中的最後一發子彈會爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire full-auto at a reduced fire rate.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 改為全自動射擊，但射速降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Commandeers 1 column from each of your other upgrade grids.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 從其他每個升級配件棋盤各徵用 1 欄。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a core refunds ammo to your magazine.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 摧毀核心時，返還彈藥至彈匣。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: On reload, a phantom Lead Flinger materializes and fires a copy of every bullet you fired prior to reloading.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 換彈時生成幻影 Lead Flinger，重現換彈前發射的每一顆子彈。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Press R during a random point in your reload to greatly increase its speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 在換彈期間隨機出現的時機按 R，可大幅加快換彈。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Firing toggles the element between fire and acid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射擊時在火焰與酸液元素間切換。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a target grants a stack of Junk. Hold R to consume all your Junk and fire a large explosive bullet with combustion size proportional to the amount of Junk consumed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺目標獲得 Junk 層數；按住 R 消耗全部層數發射大型爆炸彈，燃爆範圍依消耗量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a target while airborne causes you to hover for a moment.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 在空中擊殺目標時，會短暫懸浮。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Magazine size is increased for each occupied cell that touches this upgrade and decreased for each empty cell that touches this.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 與此配件相接的每個已占用格子，都會增加彈匣容量；相接的每個空格則會降低彈匣容量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Each shot fires 3 bullets with reduced damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每次射擊會發射 3 發傷害較低的子彈。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Aim zoom is increased. Range is greatly increase while aiming.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 瞄準倍率提高。瞄準時，射程大幅增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a core causes an elemental explosion.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 摧毀核心時，引發元素爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain damage resistance while punching.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 揮拳時獲得傷害抗性。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 3 (requires 5 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Throw out punches much faster. Melee damage and range are increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 出拳更快，並提高近戰傷害與範圍。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Sporelift creates an explosion that's larger the longer your charged it.
upgrades.descriptionZh: Sporelift 產生爆炸，蓄力越久，爆炸範圍越大。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Infection passively builds up to the given threshold.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 感染值會自動累積至指定門檻。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fully charged Sporelifts launch you in whatever direction you're looking.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 完全蓄力的 Sporelift 會朝視線方向發射自己。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fungal Skewer deals damage in a larger radius.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大 Fungal Skewer 的傷害半徑。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fungal Skewer only cleanses infection if you're inside it. Move faster the more of your health has been consumed after reaching max infection.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 只有站在 Fungal Skewer 範圍內才清除感染；達到最大感染後，被感染消耗的生命越多，移動越快。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Releasing your stem also launches you forward
upgrades.descriptionZh: 放開菌莖時，也會將自己向前彈射。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Create an explosion when you reach max infection.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 感染達到上限時產生爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 3 (requires 5 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fungal Skewer applies cryo.
upgrades.descriptionZh: Fungal Skewer 施加冰凍效果。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your melee applies decay.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 近戰施加衰變效果。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 3 (requires 5 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You now build infection when taking damage from any source.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到任何來源的傷害都會累積感染。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fungal Skewer applies the given element.
upgrades.descriptionZh: Fungal Skewer 施加指定元素。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold F to fire a beam of damaging eyeballs that apply decay proportional to your infection.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住 F 發射造成傷害的眼球光束，依感染值施加衰變。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Awarded as a special drop.
upgrades.acquisitionZh: 特殊掉落獎勵；此來源未列更詳細條件。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Pull a fungal skewer from the ground that immobilizes enemies and consumes infection for extra damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 從地面拉出菌刺，使敵人無法移動，並消耗感染值造成額外傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Innate ability of Mycologist, available from the start.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fungal Skewer radius increases with your infection.
upgrades.descriptionZh: Fungal Skewer 的半徑隨感染值增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fungal Skewer is taller.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使 Fungal Skewer 更高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Double-tap Sprint to enter hypersprint, building infection and pushing away small enemies.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 連按兩次衝刺進入超速衝刺，累積感染並推開小型敵人。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Awarded by redeeming the 2FA Code: Mycologist item.
upgrades.acquisitionZh: 兌換「2FA Code: Mycologist」道具取得。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Take their fans for yourself. You deserve it.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 把他們的粉絲據為己有，這是你應得的。（來源為背景敘述。）
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Whenever an element is fully applied to you, release a burst that applies the same element to nearby targets after a short delay.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 自己被完整施加某元素時，短暫延遲後向附近目標釋放同元素衝擊。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 6 (requires 18 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 6 階（需先花費 18 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain an additional Sporelift charge
upgrades.descriptionZh: 增加一次 Sporelift 使用次數。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 6 (requires 18 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 6 階（需先花費 18 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold Q to create a platform beneath you when you're airbone. Heal over time while standing on your platform.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滯空時按住 Q 在腳下生成平台；站在自己的平台上時持續回血。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 3 (requires 5 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Move faster when you're fully infected.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 完全感染時提高移動速度。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Using Fungal Skewer heals you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用 Fungal Skewer 時治療自己。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 3 (requires 5 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fungal Skewer partially recharges Sporelift.
upgrades.descriptionZh: Fungal Skewer 為 Sporelift 恢復部分充能。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 3 (requires 5 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your fire rate is greatly increased for a short time after reaching max infection.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 感染達到上限後，短時間內大幅提高射速。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain a burst of move speed when you release Sporelift, proportional to how long you held the stalk.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 釋放 Sporelift 時獲得短暫移速爆發，加成隨握住菌莖的時間提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Sporelift launches you with more force.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 提高 Sporelift 的發射推力。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 1 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 1 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Sporelift doesn't build infection outside of combat.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 非戰鬥狀態使用 Sporelift 不會累積感染。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Sporelift recharges faster.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 加快 Sporelift 充能。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 1 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 1 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Mushroom Cap is larger.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大 Mushroom Cap 平台。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fungal Skewer creates tall antigravity fields.
upgrades.descriptionZh: Fungal Skewer 產生高聳的反重力力場。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: After using Fungal Skewer, additional skewers sprout around it.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用 Fungal Skewer 後，周圍會再長出額外菌刺。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold Space in the air to drift when Sporelift is recharging. Drifting builds infection.
upgrades.descriptionZh: Sporelift 充能中，在空中按住空白鍵可飄浮；飄浮會累積感染。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Infection increases your melee damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 感染值提高近戰傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fungal Skewer deals increased damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 提高 Fungal Skewer 的傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Mycologist skill tree at Tier 1 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Mycologist 技能樹第 1 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Discs no longer have a cooldown and cost reserve ammo from your primary weapons. Ammo reserves gradually recharge over time.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤不再有冷卻，改為消耗主武器備彈；備彈隨時間逐漸恢復。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Maximum charges are increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 增加最大使用次數。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: DiscWorld was shut down by Saxon circa 4069 after a major incident involving the death of 233 guests.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 約在 4069 年，一場造成 233 名遊客死亡的重大事故後，Saxon 關閉了 DiscWorld。（來源為背景敘述。）
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Outgoing damage matching your attuned element is increased, but any other damage is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 提高與調諧元素相同的輸出傷害，但降低其他傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Discs travel further after hitting a surface.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤碰到表面後可行進更遠。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Discs have a random element, regardless of your attunement.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤改為隨機元素，不受調諧影響。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Explosion size and tumble distance are increased, but you have fewer charges.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 提高爆炸範圍與翻滾距離，但減少使用次數。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Disc damage is briefly increased after throwing a disc.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 投出飛盤後，短暫提高飛盤傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Sliding will periodically throw out your grenade without consuming a charge. Stacking this upgrade throws additional grenades.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滑行時，會定期拋出不消耗使用次數的手榴彈。疊加此升級配件可拋出額外的手榴彈。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Outgoing damage has a chance convert to your attuned element.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 輸出傷害有機率轉成調諧元素。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Taking damage from any source other than your grenade provides some grenade charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到自身手榴彈以外的任何來源傷害時，獲得部分手榴彈能量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.nameEn: In For A Penny, In For A Pound
upgrades.descriptionEn: Taking damage from any source other than your grenade has a small chance to toss out a grenade. This chance is proportional to the amount of damage taken.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到自身手榴彈以外的任何來源傷害時，有小機率拋出一枚手榴彈。此機率與受到的傷害量成正比。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Awarded as a special drop.
upgrades.acquisitionZh: 特殊掉落獎勵；此來源未列更詳細條件。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades cost health to fire and no longer have a cooldown.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 發射手榴彈改為消耗生命，並取消冷卻時間。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: After tumbling, discs switch direction and tumble again.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤翻滾後改變方向，再次翻滾。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Directly hitting a target causes the disc to bounce toward another enemy.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 直接命中目標時，飛盤會彈向另一名敵人。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage increases the further your discs travel. Base damage is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤行進越遠，傷害越高；降低基礎傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Commandeers 1 column from each of your other upgrade grids.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 從其他每個升級配件棋盤各徵用 1 欄。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Outgoing damage matching your attuned element is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 提高與調諧元素相同的輸出傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Toss out an additional disc.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 額外投出一枚飛盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.nameEn: Pocket Grenade (Wait Why is This One Legal?)
upgrades.nameZh: 口袋手榴彈（這顆為何合法？）
upgrades.descriptionEn: Discs are less powerful and recharge much faster.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 降低飛盤威力，但大幅加快充能。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Tossing out a disc while sprinting increases its explosion size.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 衝刺時投出的飛盤，爆炸範圍更大。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Photon Discs recharge faster while your attuned element is fully applied to you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 自己被完整施加調諧元素時，加快 Photon Discs 充能。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your move speed is briefly increased after tossing a disc.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 投出飛盤後短暫提高移動速度。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: When a disc directly hits a target, it deals much more damage and no longer tumbles.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤直接命中目標時，造成更高傷害，但不再翻滾。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Discs lightly magnetize toward targets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤會輕微吸向目標。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Discs spawn health chunks after tumbling.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤翻滾後生成生命碎塊。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your attunement switches to the element of whatever weapon you're holding if that element is fire, shock, or acid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手持武器的元素若為火焰、電擊或酸液，調諧元素便會切換成該元素。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Cooldown is reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 縮短冷卻時間。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plates travel faster and can be fired more often.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤飛行速度提高，且可更頻繁地發射。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plates automatically recall on impact.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤撞擊後會自動召回。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plates create a bee explosion when recalled.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 召回飛盤時，飛盤會引發蜂群爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plates bounce. Damage increases with each bounce.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤會彈跳，且每次彈跳都會提高傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your movement ability is partially recharged when you electrocute a target with the Plate Launcher.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以 Plate Launcher 使目標觸電時，部分恢復移動技能能量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Intermittently heal while standing on one of your plates.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 站在自己的盤子上時，間歇性治療自己。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plates spin, slicing things around them with light blades.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤旋轉，以光刃切割周圍物體。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: You may fire 3 additional plates before recalling.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 召回前可額外發射 3 個盤子。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Shoot a plate with an element to create an elemental explosion.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以元素射擊飛盤，會引發元素爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plates apply decay.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤施加衰敗。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plate Launcher battery capacity is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: Plate Launcher 的電池容量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plates apply shock.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤施加電擊。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fired plates arc lightning to each other, dealing shock damage to targets between them. Magazine size is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射出的飛盤會在彼此之間放出連鎖閃電，對中間的目標造成電擊傷害。彈匣容量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: While standing on one of your plates, you gain damage resistance and all of your outgoing damage is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 站在自己的盤子上時，獲得傷害抗性並提高全部輸出傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plates consume grenade charge to detonate on impact.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 盤子消耗手榴彈充能，並在撞擊時爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Catching a plate while mid-air boosts you upward.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 在空中接住飛盤時，會將你向上推升。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Commandeers 1 column from each of your other upgrade grids.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 從其他每個升級配件棋盤各徵用 1 欄。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased and you move faster while holding the Plate Launcher, but you take damage when catching or redirecting a plate. You take less damage at larger magazine sizes.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手持 Plate Launcher 時提高傷害與移速，但接住或轉向盤子會傷害自己；彈匣容量越大，自傷越低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Firing a plate while you are corroded causes it to create an acid puddle on impact.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 處於腐蝕狀態時發射的飛盤，會在撞擊時產生酸液池。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plates recall faster.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤召回速度提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plate damage is greatly increased while returning to the gun and after bouncing.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤返回槍械途中，以及彈跳後的傷害大幅提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plates are fired at higher speeds.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤發射速度提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Magnetism goes both ways.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 磁力是雙向的。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire more plates at a faster rate. Plate size is reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以更快速度發射更多飛盤。飛盤尺寸縮小。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plates pierce through targets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤可穿透目標。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plates create a shockwave on impact that pushes back enemies.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤撞擊時產生衝擊波，擊退敵人。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plate damage is increased the further they travel.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤飛行越遠，傷害越高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased, but so is spread.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害提高，但散布範圍也會增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plate size is increased for each empty cell surrounding this one.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 此配件周圍每個空格，都會增加飛盤尺寸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plates travel slower and fall much faster, but their size is greatly increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤飛行速度降低、下墜速度大幅提高，但尺寸大幅增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Press or hold  after firing a plate to redirect it. You can hold a maximum of one plate.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 發射盤子後按下或按住轉向鍵，使盤子改向；最多只能持有一個盤子。（來源未標示按鍵。）
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Awarded as a special drop.
upgrades.acquisitionZh: 特殊掉落獎勵；此來源未列更詳細條件。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Plates travel slower and deal more damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 飛盤飛行速度降低，但傷害提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Jetpack pushes you forward.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 噴射背包會將你向前推進。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Scrapper skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Scrapper 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: The first time you melee while attached to your Grapple Pole, you throw out a beehive that causes a bee explosion on impact.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 連接抓鉤柱期間，第一次近戰攻擊會拋出蜂巢，撞擊時引發蜜蜂爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Scrapper skill tree at Tier 6 (requires 18 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Scrapper 技能樹第 6 階（需先花費 18 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Release your fuel much faster in a stronger burst of speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以更快的速度釋放燃料，產生更強的瞬間加速。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Scrapper skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Scrapper 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Jump force is greatly increased when crouching.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 蹲下時，跳躍力量大幅提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Scrapper skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Scrapper 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Jetpack recharges faster.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 噴射背包的充能速度提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Scrapper skill tree at Tier 3 (requires 5 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Scrapper 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Melee an explosive part to instantly start its fuse and increase its explosion size.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以近戰攻擊命中爆炸零件，立即啟動其引信，並擴大爆炸範圍。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Scrapper skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Scrapper 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Create an elemental explosion at your position the first time you use your Grapple Pole.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 第一次使用抓鉤柱時，在你的位置產生元素爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Scrapper skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Scrapper 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Use less grapple pole energy while the chosen element is fully applied to you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 指定元素完全施加於你時，抓鉤柱的能量消耗降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Scrapper skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Scrapper 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Create an elemental explosion when you collect a large health chunk. Collecting smaller health chunks provides a stacking damage boost. Enemy cores always drop at least 1 health chunk.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 拾取大型生命碎塊時，產生元素爆炸。拾取較小的生命碎塊時，獲得可堆疊的傷害加成。敵人核心必定掉落至少 1 個生命碎塊。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Awarded by redeeming the 2FA Code: Scrapper item.
upgrades.acquisitionZh: 兌換「2FA Code: Scrapper」道具取得。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 將 Grapple Pole 變成懸浮眼球，可按鍵將眼球移往新位置。（來源未標示按鍵。）

upgrades.acquisitionZh: 特殊掉落獎勵；此來源未列更詳細條件。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 指定元素完全施加於你時，抓鉤柱恢復部分能量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Scrapper skill tree at Tier 3 (requires 5 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Scrapper 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You move faster for each stack of scrap you have. Scrap decays faster.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每層廢料都會提高移動速度。廢料消退得更快。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Scrapper skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Scrapper 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: While using your Grapple Pole, your Jetpack recharges faster.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用抓鉤柱期間，噴射背包的充能速度提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Scrapper skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Scrapper 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Jetpack duration is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 噴射背包的持續時間延長。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Scrapper 技能樹第 1 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 抓鉤柱第一次耗盡能量時，恢復部分能量，並將指定元素完全施加於你。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Scrapper skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Scrapper 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 非戰鬥狀態下，抓鉤持續時間大幅延長。所有使用你抓鉤柱的玩家皆適用。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Scrapper 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 玩家脫離你的抓鉤柱時，獲得瞬間加速。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住跳躍向上升高。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 最多可同時放置兩根抓鉤柱。

upgrades.acquisitionZh: Scrapper 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 與其他玩家同時使用鉤索立柱時，降低立柱能量消耗。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Scrapper skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Scrapper 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 將 Grapple Pole 接到玩家身上，使其成為鉤索節點；鉤向玩家時能量消耗較慢。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Swing into enemies to damage them.

upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈會受磁力吸引而飛向敵人。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: When you're at critical health, throwing your grenade partially recharges your movement ability.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 生命值危急時，投擲手榴彈可恢復部分移動技能能量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Explosion size is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 爆炸範圍增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: If your grenade explosion hits an ignited target, it creates a second damaging explosion.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈爆炸若命中被點燃的目標，會產生第二次傷害爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Throw grenades with more force.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 投擲手榴彈的力量提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades fire lightning strikes downward as they fly.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈飛行時，會向下釋放雷擊。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Sliding will periodically throw out your grenade without consuming a charge. Stacking this upgrade throws additional grenades.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滑行時，會定期拋出不消耗使用次數的手榴彈。疊加此升級配件可拋出額外的手榴彈。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Any outgoing damage matching this grenade's element is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 你造成的傷害若與此手榴彈的元素相同，傷害會提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades deal less damage in a very small radius, but recharge much faster.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 大幅縮小手榴彈範圍並降低傷害，但大幅加快充能。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Taking damage from any source other than your grenade provides some grenade charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到自身手榴彈以外的任何來源傷害時，獲得部分手榴彈能量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.nameEn: In For A Penny, In For A Pound
upgrades.descriptionEn: Taking damage from any source other than your grenade has a small chance to toss out a grenade. This chance is proportional to the amount of damage taken.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到自身手榴彈以外的任何來源傷害時，有小機率拋出一枚手榴彈。此機率與受到的傷害量成正比。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Awarded as a special drop.
upgrades.acquisitionZh: 特殊掉落獎勵；此來源未列更詳細條件。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades cost health to fire and no longer have a cooldown.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 發射手榴彈改為消耗生命，並取消冷卻時間。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenade applies less of its element to you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈對你施加的元素量減少。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenades launch you straight up when hitting you.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈命中你時，會將你垂直向上彈飛。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: When Livewire is active, you move even faster and can't stop sprinting.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 帶電之軀（Livewire）生效期間，移動速度進一步提高，且無法停止衝刺。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: You become the grenade, exploding multiple times and gaining increased move speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 你會化身手榴彈，多次爆炸並提高移動速度。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Move faster while your grenade is recharging.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈充能期間，移動速度提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Commandeers 1 column from each of your other upgrade grids.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 從其他每個升級配件棋盤各徵用 1 欄。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenades phase through shields.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈會穿過護盾。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain grenade energy when you electrocute a target with another weapon.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用其他武器使目標觸電時，獲得手榴彈能量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your grenade recharges faster while sliding.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滑行期間，手榴彈的充能速度提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades stun enemies.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈會使敵人暈眩。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionZh: 被手榴彈爆炸擊中的玩家，短暫提高移動速度。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Grenades launch you away from the explosion.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 手榴彈會將你向爆炸中心以外的方向彈飛。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住 R 為 Shocklance 蓄力，放開後向前衝出，持續鑽擊路徑上的目標；多份此配件可提高傷害與衝刺時間。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased, but so is charge-up time.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害提高，但蓄能時間也增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Consecutive shots are fired full-auto without needing to charge up.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 後續射擊改為全自動連射，無須重新蓄能。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionZh: 傷害與蓄能時間大幅增加。

upgrades.descriptionZh: 備用彈藥量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: While firing, extra pellets are created from nearby players who have a Swarm Launcher equipped.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射擊時，附近裝備 Swarm Launcher 的玩家身上會產生額外彈丸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: While airborne, you automatically spawn swarm pellets in front of you. Their fire rate increases the longer you're in the air. This can trigger when the Swarm Launcher is not equipped.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 在空中時，會自動在面前產生蜂群彈丸。滯空越久，射速越高。未手持 Swarm Launcher 時也可觸發。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Pellets can track to players and heal them.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈丸可追蹤玩家並治療他們。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Pellets apply shock.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈丸施加電擊。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Pellets explode but deal less damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈丸會爆炸，但傷害降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Pellets spray forward with full target tracking. Magazine size and ammo capacity are greatly increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈丸朝前方散射並完整追蹤目標；大幅增加彈匣與備彈容量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire slower, high-damage pellets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 發射速度更慢、傷害更高的彈丸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Magazine size is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈匣容量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: You can fire while sprinting and sliding.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 可在衝刺與滑行時射擊。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hovering pellets consume your ammo reserves to release a rain of diving pellets that deal reduced damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 懸浮彈丸會消耗你的備用彈藥，釋放向下俯衝的彈雨；這些彈丸的傷害較低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Commandeers 1 column from each of your other upgrade grids.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 從其他每個升級配件棋盤各徵用 1 欄。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold R to consume reserve ammo and gain charge for your equipped grenade.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住 R 消耗備彈，為目前裝備的手榴彈充能。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Range and accuracy are increased, but magazine size is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射程與精準度提高，但彈匣容量降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold R charge up a high powered melee attack.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住 R 為高威力近戰攻擊蓄力。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hold R to consume reserve ammo and regenerate health.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 按住 R 消耗備彈，恢復生命。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Reload speed is decreased, but you move much faster while reloading.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填速度降低，但裝填期間的移動速度大幅提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Range is increased while aiming.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 瞄準時，射程增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire a shot of 6 pellets. Magazine size and ammo capacity are increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每次射出 6 顆彈丸。彈匣容量與彈藥攜帶量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Releasing the swarm before your magazine is empty gives you a burst of speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 在彈匣耗盡前釋放蜂群，可獲得短暫的速度提升。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire faster with lower accuracy.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射速提高，但精準度降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Hovering pellets follow your crosshair but travel slower.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 懸浮彈丸會跟隨準星，但飛行速度降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire all pellets at once. Magazine size is decreased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 一次射出所有彈丸。彈匣容量降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Range and spread are both increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射程與散布範圍皆增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Electrocuting a target with any weapon increases the Swarm Launcher's reload speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以任何武器使目標觸電時，提高 Swarm Launcher 的裝填速度。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Ammo reserves are increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 備用彈藥量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Magazine size is increased for each unique upgrade that touches this one.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每個與此配件相接的不同升級配件，都會增加彈匣容量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Spread is reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 散布縮小。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Regenerate more Swarm Launcher ammo from dealing damage with your other weapon. Ammo capacity is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用另一把武器造成傷害時，可恢復更多 Swarm Launcher 彈藥。彈藥攜帶量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Pellet damage increases the longer they hover.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈丸懸浮越久，傷害越高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Bullets apply acid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 子彈施加酸液。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Toss a ball of water when you reload. Reload speed is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 裝填時拋出一顆水球。裝填速度提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Ammo reserves are increased but recoil is more intense.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 備用彈藥增加，但後座力加劇。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire double bullets in vertical mode. Damage is reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 垂直模式下發射雙倍子彈。傷害降低。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Ammo reserves are increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 備用彈藥量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a target refunds some ammo.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺目標時，返還部分彈藥。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Magazine size is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈匣容量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased for a short time after you are corroded.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 受到腐蝕後，短時間內傷害提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Slide speed is briefly increased after killing a target.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺目標後，滑行速度短暫提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Aim zoom is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 提高瞄準放大倍率。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擴大升級配件棋盤。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire rate is increased, but you must charge up before shooting.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 射速提高，但開火前必須先蓄能。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire rate is increased after igniting a target.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 點燃目標後，射速提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Bullets apply fire.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 子彈施加火焰。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased but fire rate is decreased. Firing is no longer automatic.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 提高傷害但降低射速，並取消全自動射擊。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your last shot deals more damage.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 最後一發造成更高傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Dealing damage has a chance to smite the area in shocking lightning strikes.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 造成傷害時，有機率在該區域降下帶有電擊效果的雷擊。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Move extremely fast after killing a hornet.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺胡蜂後，移動速度大幅提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Magazine size is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈匣容量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased while aiming.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 瞄準時傷害提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire a single high-damage shot while aiming.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 瞄準時發射單發高傷害彈藥。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Commandeers 1 column from each of your other upgrade grids.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 從其他每個升級配件棋盤各徵用 1 欄。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire a single arc of plasma that deals damage in a small area.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 發射一道電漿弧，在小範圍內造成傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a core has a chance to refund a large amount of ammo.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺核心時，有機率退還大量彈藥。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: You deal extra damage to corroded targets.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 對受到腐蝕的目標造成額外傷害。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Continuous firing spins up to a much faster fire rate.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 持續射擊會逐漸加速，使射速大幅提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Aim zoom is increased. While aiming, fire rate and spread are decreased and range is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 提高瞄準倍率；瞄準時降低射速與散布，並提高射程。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire a 4-round burst. Magazine size is slightly increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以 4 發點放射擊。彈匣容量略微增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Electrocuting a target with another weapon gives you stacks of tailwind. Consume stacks while firing the Trident to move faster.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 用另一把武器使目標觸電會獲得 Tailwind 層數；Trident 射擊時消耗層數，提高移動速度。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Killing a core grants additional charge to your ability that's closest to full charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺核心時，為目前最接近充滿的技能額外補充能量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Magazine size and ammo capacity are increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 彈匣容量與彈藥攜帶量增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Damage is increased for each rare cell surrounding this upgrade. Recoil is increased for each other cell.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 此配件周圍每有一格 Rare（稀有）格位，傷害就提高；其餘每一格都會增加後座力。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Fire rate, recoil, and spread are increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 提高射速、後座力與散布。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Found in the world drop pool.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Jump while airborne to dash forward.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滯空時再跳躍可向前衝刺。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Innate ability of Wrangler, available from the start.

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your equipped weapon is partially reloaded when you throw your lasso.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 拋出套索時，為目前手持的武器裝填部分彈藥。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Attempting to use your Rocket Lasso while it's recharging damages you and grants some charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭套索充能期間嘗試使用它，會傷害自己並獲得部分能量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Lassoing a broken player part refunds some Rocket Lasso charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 用套索套住玩家破損的零件時，返還部分火箭套索能量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Briefly gain immunity after using your air dash.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用空中衝刺後，短暫獲得無敵效果。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You can aim while sliding.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滑行時可以瞄準。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 1 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 1 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: You periodically mark a nearby medium or large enemy for death, gaining increased damage against it. Killing a marked enemy moves the mark to another nearby enemy.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 定期將附近一名中型或大型敵人標記為死亡目標，提高你對它的傷害。擊殺標記敵人後，標記會轉移至附近另一名敵人。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Awarded by redeeming the 2FA Code: Wrangler item.
upgrades.acquisitionZh: 兌換「2FA Code: Wrangler」道具取得。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain a second Air Dash charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 空中衝刺可額外儲存 1 次使用次數。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 6 (requires 18 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 6 階（需先花費 18 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Gain a second Rocket Lasso charge.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭套索可額外儲存 1 次使用次數。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Jump out of a slide to gain a burst of upward speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 滑行中起跳，獲得一次向上加速。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your lasso explodes.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 套索會爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Rocket Lasso range is increased for each cell that touches this upgrade.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 每有一格與此配件接觸，火箭套索射程就會增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 3 (requires 5 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Eyes have a chance to sprout from targets you kill. Destroy an eye to gain health and a stacking bonus to damage and move speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 擊殺的目標有機率長出眼球；摧毀眼球可恢復生命，並獲得可疊加的傷害與移速加成。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Awarded as a special drop.
upgrades.acquisitionZh: 特殊掉落獎勵；此來源未列更詳細條件。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Push nearby targets in the direction of your air dash.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 將附近目標朝空中衝刺的方向推開。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Melee a surface below you to launch yourself upward.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 近戰攻擊下方表面，可將自己向上彈射。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 5 (requires 14 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 5 階（需先花費 14 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Slide speed is briefly increased after using your Air Dash.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用空中衝刺後，滑行速度短暫提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Pulling a health chunk with your lasso equips it. Throw the chunk to create a healing explosion.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 用套索拉回生命碎塊時，會將它拿在手上。投擲碎塊可產生治療爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 3 (requires 5 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Lasso a Hornet to push it away.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 用套索套住胡蜂可將它推開。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 3 (requires 5 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Slide when landing to roll and gain a burst of speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 落地時滑行，可翻滾並獲得一次短促加速。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 1 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 1 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Air Dash duration is increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 空中衝刺持續時間增加。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 3 (requires 5 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 3 階（需先花費 5 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Rocket Lasso range and force are increased.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭套索射程與力量提高。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: When landing with enough force, some of your vertical momentum is converted to horizontal speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 以足夠的力量落地時，部分垂直動量會轉成水平速度。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Using a quip gives you a burst of speed.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用俏皮話時，獲得一次短促加速。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Creates an explosion at your current position when you use your Rocket Lasso.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 使用火箭套索時，在目前位置產生爆炸。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Your Rocket Lasso has a chance to partially recharge when you fully apply the given element to a target.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 對目標完整施加指定元素效果時，有機率為火箭套索補充部分能量。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 4 (requires 9 skill points spent).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 4 階（需先花費 9 點技能點）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Rocket Lasso cooldown is reduced.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 火箭套索冷卻時間縮短。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。

upgrades.descriptionEn: Lasso a surface directly in front of you to launch yourself away from it.
upgrades.descriptionZh: 用套索套住正前方表面，可將自己朝反方向彈射。
upgrades.acquisitionEn: Source: Unlocked from the Wrangler skill tree at Tier 2 (starter ability).
upgrades.acquisitionZh: Wrangler 技能樹第 2 階（初始能力）。
